# Awesome KB — Automotive Security

> A knowledge base ingesting the curated awesome list hexsecs/awesome-automotive-security (the list is canon; this KB is the derived layer). One page per resource, concept pages for synthesis, and a JSON index for machines.

## Machine layer

- [Index (JSON)](https://github.com/hexsecs/awesome-kb-automotive-security/blob/main/index.json): every entry — slug, title, URL, source section, status, page path.
- [Spec](https://github.com/hexsecs/awesome-kb-automotive-security/blob/main/SPEC.md): the format this KB follows.

## Entry pages

Entry pages live in `entries/<slug>.md`; resolve a slug through index.json. Pages with status `full` carry verified depth; `stub` pages carry the list's own description and provenance.
